name: Triscuit Original Whole Wheat Crackers (Abrasive Woven Wheat Hazard)
whyItWorks: Triscuits are made of coarse, shredded whole wheat berries woven into a dense mesh. The sharp, prickly wheat fibers resist digestive softening and act like steel wool against inflamed mucosa, posing an acute obstruction hazard in stricturing Crohn's.
prepOrOrderInstructions: High Stricture Warning: Avoid Triscuits and shredded wheat cereals if you have Crohn's disease, strictures, or active colitis. Choose smooth Saltines, Ritz, or Club crackers instead.
watchOuts: Sharp woven wheat fibers can lodge in strictured bowel segments and severely abrade ulcerated tissue.
